cells.action: Per D1, D3 with its refinement 32492fc4, and D5. (1) run.rs: at each of the three spawn sites that write `"created_at": chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),` also write `base_sha`: the cwd's HEAD commit read through one small helper that runs the version-control CLI with `-C <cwd>` and `rev-parse HEAD` the way worktree_fingerprint in herding.rs runs it, null when the cwd is not a checkout; one helper, three call sites. (2) Add `bee detector tick [--json]` to verbs/detector.rs, register `detector.tick` (flag json) in generated/registry_payload.json in the same shape as `detector.events`, and add a catalog.rs resolve test. The tick resolves the control root, lists every `.bee/mailbox/<job>/job.json`, and treats a job as live when `result-<round>.json` is absent for the job's `round` (default 1). It loads the job's cell record with `crate::verbs::cells::read_cell` when `cell_id` is set; with no cell only the ceiling and token rules apply. The changed set: `diff --name-only <base_sha>` plus `ls-files --others --exclude-standard`, both through the same CLI helper against the job cwd, repo-relative paths, minus every path under `.bee/` or `docs/decisions/`; `base_sha` is job.json `base_sha`, else the value stored in the job's detector state file, else the cwd's HEAD captured now and stored there (the first tick of an old job then sees only untracked paths). Rules, each firing at most one event per (job_id, signal, point_key) — before appending, skip any triple already present in events.jsonl: budget-80 (a) ceiling: now minus `continued_at` when present else `created_at`, at or above 0.8 times `ceiling_secs`, point_key `budget-80-ceiling-<job_id>`; (b) claims: `attempts_since_budget_reset(cell).len() + 1` at or above 0.8 times `resolve_cell_budgets(cell).max_claims`, point_key `budget-80-claims-<job_id>`; (c) tokens: job.json `usage.total_tokens` (the last finished round) at or above 0.8 times config `herding.budget.tokens_per_job` when that key is a positive number, point_key `budget-80-tokens-<job_id>`. test-on-unstable-contract: walk the cell's `decisions` once with the hoisted reads the way handlers_write.rs does around `contract_status_over(`; for each id naming an active decision with a `contract:<name>` tag whose status is Unsettled, when the changed set holds a test path (a `tests/` or `spec/` path segment, or a file name matching `*_test.*`, `*.test.*` or `*_tests.*`), fire with point_key `unstable-contract-<name>-<job_id>`. boundary-approach: when the cell's `files` is non-empty, every changed path for which `declared_covers(files, path)` is false fires with point_key `boundary-approach-<job_id>-<key>` where `<key>` is the first 8 hex chars of sha256(path); the excerpt carries the path. self-correction: read `.bee/supervisor/detector/<job_id>.json` (`{base_sha, changed_paths: [..], at}`); every path present there and absent from the current changed set fires with point_key `self-correction-<job_id>-<key>` (same key rule); then write the current set and base_sha to that file (create the directory on first write). Every event carries `cell_id`, `target_session` = job.json `leader_session`, `source` naming the surface (`job.json`, `cell`, `diff`, `config`), and an `excerpt` of one sentence holding the numbers or the path. A job whose job.json is unreadable, whose cwd is missing, or whose cwd is not a checkout prints one warning line on stderr and is skipped; the tick exits 0 unless the store itself cannot be written. Output: with `--json` `{fired: [events], scanned: n}`; text form one line per fired event in the `detector events` shape and a final line `detector: scanned <n> jobs, fired <m>`. Expose pub(crate) `tick_quiet(control_root: &Path) -> usize` returning the fired count with warnings on stderr, for det-3. Tests on tempdir fixtures (a real checkout per job cwd, job.json and cell records written as plain JSON in the shapes the writers use): every det-2 row of the plan's test matrix, plus the dedupe case (second tick fires none).
